description.en: Voice-emotion input for the DSH composer: records one utterance, transcribes it locally, estimates tone and emotion from prosody and text cues, and sends a constrained emotion-aware prompt. Uses DSH Voice Input in lightweight mode or an optional VoiceSense + emotion2vec backend.
description.zh: DSH 输入框语音情绪插件：录制一段语音，在本机转写，并根据韵律与文字线索估计语气和情绪，发送带受控情绪上下文的提示词。轻量模式复用 DSH Voice Input，也可选配 VoiceSense + emotion2vec 增强后端。
